# Live Subtitles

> Live Subtitles is an app for Windows, macOS, iOS and Android that shows real-time
> AI captions and dual (two-language) subtitles for any audio playing on the
> device — Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Skype, YouTube, Netflix, games and
> any other app. The audio source is switchable: it captures system audio directly,
> or listens through the microphone for talks, lectures and in-person conversations.
> Speech is transcribed and translated live into 50+ languages, with the
> original and translated line shown together.

Key facts:
- Product: Live Subtitles (publisher: Live Subtitles)
- Platforms: Windows (Microsoft Store), macOS and iOS (App Store), Android (Google Play); a TV version is in development
- Microsoft Store rating: 4.7/5 from 351+ ratings
- Pricing: free minutes to start on install, no credit card; subscriptions from $5.83/month (Basic annual) or $6.99/month; one-time minute packs that never expire (https://live-subtitles.com/pricing.html)
- Core features: real-time captions from system audio or the microphone, dual subtitles
  (original + translation), 50+ languages for recognition and translation,
  works offline with local models or online providers, Game Mode overlay
- Typical uses: multilingual meetings, watching foreign movies/videos, language
  learning with dual subtitles, accessibility (deaf/hard-of-hearing), gaming

## Main pages

- [Home](https://live-subtitles.com/): overview, demo and download
- [Pricing](https://live-subtitles.com/pricing.html): plans and prices
- [Microsoft Store listing](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9ph1r9djg47s): Windows download
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/live-captions-translator/id6760197210): macOS and iOS download
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.livesubtitles.android): Android download
- [Live captions and dual subtitles on Android](https://live-subtitles.com/android-live-captions.html): floating overlay over any Android app plus a microphone mode for in-person conversations, 50+ languages, free to try
- [Live Captions & Transcribe](https://live-subtitles.com/captions/): sister app for Windows 10/11 — real-time captions in the spoken language (no translation), large text, speaker colors, transcript history with TXT/SRT export
  - [How to get live captions on Windows 10](https://live-subtitles.com/captions/windows-10-live-captions.html): Windows 10 has no built-in Live Captions; options compared (Live Captions & Transcribe for any sound on the PC, Chrome Live Caption for browser audio, captions inside Zoom/Teams/Meet/YouTube) with steps
  - [Windows 11 Live Captions vs Live Captions & Transcribe](https://live-subtitles.com/captions/windows-11-live-captions-vs-live-captions-transcribe.html): when the free built-in captions are enough, and when you need Windows 10 support, transcript history, SRT export or speaker colors
